## MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the Current Market Regime?**
RISK-ON: low volatility and broad participation; Vol: 19.6%, Breadth: 8/8 sectors positive.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy & Chemicals leading: SASA (1W: +28.38% | 1M: +20.00%) ABOVE TREND; Technology & Telecom: TTKOM (1W: +10.60% | 1M: +4.46%) ABOVE TREND; Retail & Food: BIMAS (1W: +3.37% | 1M: +14.14%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Banking showing relative lag vs the leaders: HALKB (1W: -13.38% | 1M: +35.91%) CORRECTION; Transportation lagging: THYAO (1W: -0.17% | 1M: -4.06%) BELOW TREND; Holding & Investment softer: DOHOL (1W: -0.28% | 1M: +2.94%) CORRECTION.

## STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
SASA (1W: +28.38% | 1M: +20.00%) ABOVE TREND; PETKM (1W: +17.95% | 1M: +25.78%) ABOVE TREND; SISE (1W: +11.36% | 1M: +4.51%) ABOVE TREND; TTKOM (1W: +10.60% | 1M: +4.46%) ABOVE TREND; HEKTS (1W: +7.58% | 1M: +0.35%) ABOVE TREND.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
OYAKC (1W: +1.02% | 1M: +1.21%) ABOVE TREND; AKBNK (1W: +0.97% | 1M: +5.07%) ABOVE TREND; TAVHL (1W: +0.09% | 1M: -3.68%) RECOVERY; GUBRF (1W: +0.00% | 1M: +14.40%) NEUTRAL; THYAO (1W: -0.17% | 1M: -4.06%) BELOW TREND.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
SASA (1W: +28.38% | 1M: +20.00%) ABOVE TREND; PETKM (1W: +17.95% | 1M: +25.78%) ABOVE TREND; SISE (1W: +11.36% | 1M: +4.51%) ABOVE TREND; TTKOM (1W: +10.60% | 1M: +4.46%) ABOVE TREND; TUPRS (1W: +7.01% | 1M: +20.16%) ABOVE TREND.

## SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Banking Sector Outlook?**
Banks participating but mixed: ISCTR (1W: +6.38% | 1M: +10.63%) ABOVE TREND and VAKBN (1W: +6.31% | 1M: +15.14%) ABOVE TREND, while HALKB (1W: -13.38% | 1M: +35.91%) CORRECTION signals stock-specific volatility—favor large-cap banks with strong 1M confirmation.

**8. Industrial Sector Outlook?**
Heavy industry constructive: EREGL (1W: +4.46% | 1M: +1.62%) ABOVE TREND and FROTO (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +2.57%) ABOVE TREND, but ASELS (1W: -4.06% | 1M: -5.87%) BELOW TREND warrants caution in defense/expo picks.

**9. Energy & Chemicals Outlook?**
Clear leadership: SASA (1W: +28.38% | 1M: +20.00%) ABOVE TREND, PETKM (1W: +17.95% | 1M: +25.78%) ABOVE TREND and TUPRS (1W: +7.01% | 1M: +20.16%) ABOVE TREND—sector driven by commodity momentum and quant scores.

## PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Risk-on stance: overweight Energy & Chemicals and select cyclicals (autos, banks) with confirmed 1M strength; trim/reduce exposure to names showing short-term corrections (HALKB, ASELS) and lock profits in extreme momentum winners.

## NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
SASA (1W: +28.38% | 1M: +20.00%) ABOVE TREND for momentum sustainability; PETKM (1W: +17.95% | 1M: +25.78%) ABOVE TREND on downstream catalysts; ISCTR (1W: +6.38% | 1M: +10.63%) ABOVE TREND for bank-led flow; HALKB (1W: -13.38% | 1M: +35.91%) CORRECTION for mean-reversion/volatility.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
Energy & Chemicals for continuation, Banking & Finance for rotation into cyclicals, Technology & Telecom for short-term momentum checks.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch XU100 near recent highs for continuation (breakout confirms risk-on flows) and a pullback into short-term moving averages as risk-off trigger; monitor global oil and USD/TRY moves plus upcoming corporate earnings and macro data as primary catalysts.

## EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
Low-volatility, broad-risk-on market led by Energy & Chemicals and select tech and retail names, with strong momentum in SASA and PETKM. Strategy: overweight cyclicals and banks with 1M confirmation, take profits on steep short-term winners and guard against idiosyncratic corrections in HALKB and ASELS.
